mainEntity.name: Is a merry-go-round the same as a carousel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For event rentals, yes — the two names are used for the same kind of ride. Search for either and you are in the right place; we source them all under carousel rentals.

mainEntity.name: Can a carousel be set up indoors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes. It depends on the model, the room's height, the floor and the way in. Tell us about the room and we check with operators before quoting.

mainEntity.name: Who sets up and runs the carousel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The carnival operator we arrange for your event delivers, sets up and operates the ride with their own crew. We coordinate the details with you and with them.

mainEntity.name: When is the carousel actually booked?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only after you accept our written quote, the operator commits to your date, and the agreed payment step is complete. A request on its own doesn't reserve a ride.
